name: SpatialGroupEnhance
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, groups):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, groups, 1, 1, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype))
    bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, groups, 1, 1, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype))
    x_reshaped = x.view(b * groups, -1, h, w)
    avg_pool = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x_reshaped, 1)
    xn = x_reshaped * avg_pool
    xn = xn.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    t = xn.view(b * groups, -1)
    t = t - t.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    std = t.std(dim=1, keepdim=True) + 1e-5
    t = t / std
    t = t.view(b, groups, h, w)
    t = t * weight + bias
    t = t.view(b * groups, 1, h, w)
    out = x_reshaped * torch.sigmoid(t)
    out = out.view(b, c, h, w)
    return out
